trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Cause:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. No approval was needed because v2.3.0 had been healthy in production before.
- **Result:** All three regions now run v2.3.0. The service reports healthy, with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to open it was rate-limited. I retried with the same idempotency key, so only one incident was created. The summary says to confirm health checks recover, but the status check after the rollback already showed the service healthy. The summary also says to find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before deploying it again.
